details: i noticed during the past 2 or 3ish days of using the new  ui 2.0 beta there are alot of bugs and glitches that seem easily replicatable within the beta. Some of which range from just standard poor performance from the immense amount of new menus and animations for them to menu animations freezing  not completely loading and causing issues where you need to restart the game to get menu functionality back such as the quick menu being faded and non interactable and when trying to toggle the quick menu leaves behind the menus base layers as a faded plane and wont normally go away until a vrc restart while opening the quick menu or loading in new user tags they will be deformed and not fully loaded leaving the name fully displayed and the speech bubble artifaced compressed into their name to not even showing the user nametag at all no matter what displays settings used for nametags. and finally the biggest issue is lack of the wing menu settings persistance every time i restart vr chat my qm and settings menu wings particularly the quick access to avatars normally break resetting to favorites and sort by last used rather than my perfered pre set settings  along with the settings menu normally freezing and refusing to work after switching from different menu tabs
title: [1238} general menu bugs & poor resource management
